title: A Contour Method for Multiparameter Eigenvalue Problems
summary: Multiparameter eigenvalue problems arise in boundary value problems, stability analysis, and delay-differential equations. Despite their importance, existing methods either require solving extremely large global problems or rely on local iterative techniques that only recover a few eigenvalues at a time. In this work we develop the first contour method for analytic multiparameter eigenvalue problems.
